en.summary:
Industrial OT environments demand high real-time performance, high reliability, strict physical constraints, and near-zero tolerance for error. The content hallucination, unpredictable logic, and runaway execution inherent to general-purpose LLMs have become the core technical barrier to deploying them at scale on the factory floor.

Industrial OT environments demand high real-time performance, high reliability, strict physical constraints, and near-zero tolerance for error. The content hallucination, unpredictable logic, and runaway execution inherent to general-purpose LLMs have become the core technical barrier to deploying them at scale on the factory floor.

Word count: 2,524
Reading time: about 8 minutes

AI Agents are shifting from Q&A assistants to task executors embedded in enterprise workflows, and engineering capability — tool calling, context management, feedback loops — has become the key bottleneck to scaling them.

The central challenge of Agent deployment has shifted to task selection, result validation, and control of permissions, cost, and risk. Coding Agents are evolving into engineering collaborators that understand codebases, run tests, and deliver work jointly. Model capability sets the ceiling; engineering architecture determines production readiness.

AI Agents are shifting from Q&A assistants to task executors embedded in enterprise workflows, and engineering capability — tool calling, context management, feedback loops — has become the key bottleneck to scaling them.

The central challenge of Agent deployment has shifted to task selection, result validation, and control of permissions, cost, and risk. Title: AI 测试 Skill 大全，我日常在用的 27个，夯爆了！
Published Time: 2026-11-05T01:21:31+00:00
之前有人问我，你天天说的 Agent Skill 到底是啥，你平常有用哪些呢？
